# Flow: escalations (comment and notification)
Load when: decision rows 5–6 of SKILL.md (escalate a due date, blocker or stale item; notify a person in LPM)

## Preconditions
1. `create_comment` works on connectors (scope portfolio:manage). `create_notification` and `list_project_assignable_members` need an LPM API key; the notification needs profile full or custom. Connector → core rule 2.
2. Prefer a comment: it stays with the activity. Send a notification only when the user asked for it and named the person ([planning-rules](planning-rules.md) Rule 5).
3. The server accepts any `userId` for a notification, even outside the workspace, and the notice looks like a system message: take the id only from step 6.

## Steps
1. `get_issue`(projectId, issueId) → keep `title`, `dueDate`, `assigneeId`, `status`.
2. Template: due date → "Due-date escalation" below; blocker or stale → [comment-templates](comment-templates.md). Write it in the user's language.
3. `create_comment`(projectId, issueId, content, idempotencyKey) [A]; due-date key `due-<issueId>-<yyyymmdd>`, other keys per [comment-templates](comment-templates.md). New text → new key.
4. Verify: `list_comments`(projectId, issueId) → the comment is present once.
5. Notification only when the user asked for one and named the person; otherwise stop after step 4.
6. `list_project_assignable_members`(projectId) → one `uid` for that person; 0 or 2+ matches → ask "Which person: <a> or <b>?". Never repeat `hourlyRate`.
7. Ask "Notify <name> (<uid>): "<title>" — <message>, type <due-date | action_required>? (yes/no)". Continue only on "yes".
8. `create_notification`(userId=<uid>, title, message, type) [C], once → id after "ID: ". Report it as unverified: no tool reads another user's inbox. An error → report it; never retry.

## Templates
```text
example: Due-date escalation (key due-<issueId>-<yyyymmdd>)
Due date at risk: <title> is due <dueDate> (in <N> days) | was due <dueDate> (<N> days late).
Owner: <assignee name | no owner>
Cause: <blocker or reason, one line | unknown>
Ask: confirm a new date or reduce scope by <YYYY-MM-DD>.
```

## Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| notification asked, no person named | "Who should receive the notification?" |
| a person matches 0 or 2+ assignable members | "Which person: <a> or <b>?" |
| a new due date is part of the escalation | SKILL.md row 3 ([flow-owners-dates](flow-owners-dates.md)): the date change is [C] |

## Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| comment | `list_comments`(projectId, issueId) | the comment is present once |
| notification | none (another user's inbox is not readable) | report the returned id and say it is unverified; never retry |

## Report fields
Scope (project, activity), comment id or key, notification id (unverified) and recipient name, Pending, Next.
